settings.text:
A few things cannot be returned, and we say which on the product itself before you buy, never afterwards.

If you want to return a Buy Now purchase, start by emailing orders@caratforus.com. We will tell you whether the item qualifies, and if it does we will issue a return authorisation with the address and the deadline. Please do not send anything back before you have that — an unannounced parcel is one we cannot match to an order or insure.

Return shipping is arranged and paid by you, and must be tracked and insured for the full value. That is not us being difficult: an uninsured parcel that disappears leaves neither of us with a remedy.

The exact terms you agreed to are below.

settings.heading: Returns and cancellations
settings.subheading: Most things we sell can be returned. Here is how, and what to expect.
settings.cta_label: Email us to start a return

settings.title: The return window
settings.items:
Returns are accepted within 14 days.
The 14 days run from the date the carrier confirms delivery, not from the date you open the parcel.
We must receive the item back within that window, so start the return as soon as you know.
Email orders@caratforus.com first. We issue a return authorisation with the address and the deadline; items sent without one cannot be matched to an order or insured.

settings.title: The condition we need it back in
settings.items:
Original, new and unworn condition.
Original packaging included.
Any IGI or other certification that came with the item, returned with it.
In its original ring size.
Return shipping is arranged and paid by you, and must be tracked and insured for the full value.

settings.title: What cannot be returned
settings.items:
Items that have been resized are not refundable, unless the item is defective.
Engraved, altered, personalised or otherwise customised items.
Luxury Steals, which are final sale.
We say so on the product itself before you buy, never afterwards.

settings.title: If something is wrong with the item
settings.text: A manufacturing defect is a different matter from a return, and it is not limited to 14 days. Every piece carries a 1-year limited manufacturing warranty, and a resized item that proves defective is still covered. Start a warranty claim rather than a return.
